author: keithmill1215
quote:
Im going to give gta the benefit of the doubt and start off by saying this game was obviously not a 13 year long project it was 6. Obviously there are a lot of glitches and bugs but that's not going to be included in my score because of the expectations and visually it is a masterpiece. 
The story ****. It doesn't feel like gta at all. The endings are basic. The entire storyline in general the voice acting it's really the worst gta story of all time all around. Hopefully they can capitalize on the open world whenever online comes out and create something actually meaningful because the only fun thing to do is just simple gta stuff which they have also cut a huge chunk out like shooting in the club and at protesters and hookers
Gta is the last game that should be encouraging empathy in the way gta 6 has done it's quite sad to see the greatest franchise take such a turn in a time that could have such a funny satire to it 
Frankly this game is so bad not only did i refund it but i have purchased an entire xbox 360 and gta 4 
The main stream critics have lost all of their credibility and this game is what has taken me out of modern gaming on the ps5 generation and back to 360 games 
I could have said so many worse things about this game but i will just let the score speak for itself
